entry_points.text: Reboot vector handler acks IRQ, tears down virtualization in emergency mode and parks CPU; reschedule and call-function vectors ack, trace and dispatch to scheduler wakeup, broadcast or single-target generic paths.

Kick scans offline CPUs for wait marker, writes kexec halt marker and rechecks briefly; AP starting zeroes handshake, brings up LAPIC, builds siblings, announces start and inits counters; INIT sequence asserts and deasserts level INIT with bus-idle waits; halt and park entries flush and loop non-returning.

User step controls and stack walkers serve debugger and tracer entries on a task and register snapshot with consumer callback; hotplug glue delegates prepare, kick, cleanup and sync to platform ops with logging and polling fallbacks.

Clone compat entry splits signal bits into exit signal and wires id pointers, stack and TLS before generic clone; mmap compat copies block and forwards page-shifted offset; log read maps fixed region, checks id, clamps to size and position, stages through kernel buffer and unmaps.

Profiler returns frame instruction address and legacy timer dispatches global clock event; late trusted-boot init builds trampoline, resets shutdown count, hooks dying CPUs, exposes read-only log and installs suspend hooks; announce and completion finalize topology, self-test and cache state.

exports.text: SMP dispatch binds boot, AP prepare, shutdown, reschedule, kick, idle and function-call IPIs to native routines with crash variant; early option disables NMI fallback; SMT rescan migrates parked siblings.

Secondary bringup validates APIC id, prepares task, stacks and FPU state, selects trampoline and secondary entry, optionally arms legacy reset vector, then tries 64-bit, legacy, then INIT wakeup with cleanup on failure.

Offline recomputes SMT limits, detaches sibling and cache maps, revokes FPU, removes online and NUMA membership, migrates interrupts, offlines LAPIC and parks in halt; boot layer covers boot-CPU prep, SMP disable, parallel bringup, completion and resume.

Tracing offers best-effort, reliable and user walkers to a consumer; static calls validate bytes, derive call, placeholder, jump or return behavior and patch sites with early primitive; step helpers linearize IP and arm single or block step.

Compat shims widen split 32-bit halves to 64-bit offsets and lengths for file, sync, advice, allocate and readahead paths, translate status records, copy mmap blocks and build clone requests; 64-bit mmap and unmapped-area services enforce granularity, windows and alignment.

Scheduler hierarchy exposes thread, cluster, core and package levels with packing flags; NUMA distance repairs sub-cluster firmware values after validation; trusted-boot lookup derives protected DMA table from heap; early handlers parse cache-split and delay options.

hazards.text: Shutdown cannot avoid interrupting lock holders, late halt reports after NMI decision, or disabled APICs reacting to NMI, so drained mask does not prove handler completion; nonzero wakeup status means failure and needs reset cleanup; post-disable interrupts are invisible to migration.

Unexpected static-call bytes or marker mismatch halt the system; user traversal must stop on backward or zero progress; local-selector linearization needs lock and bounds with all-ones fallback; early microcode load relies on primary-before-secondary order and external serialization.

Visible failures include copy faults, misaligned offsets rejected, oversized or unplaceable mappings out of memory, unsupported sleeps rejected, reduced-hardware suspend reporting no device, shutdown races busy, trampoline failures halting, and log map or alloc faults.

Many referenced APIC, topology, printk, lock, mm, scheduler and firmware helpers live outside this dossier and their internals were not read; behavior beyond shown fragments for controllers, dispatch, parking, hotplug, calibration and table parsing is absent.

invariants.text: Peer shutdown elects one initiator atomically, skips when forced, kicks monitor-wait parked CPUs under kexec, builds stop mask, broadcasts reboot vector, polls about one second, then optionally uses NMI stop callback, waits, disables APIC, clears machine checks and drains mask.

TSC is unsynchronized when feature missing or unstable or under clustered topology unless constant or reliable holds, with multi-package rule off Intel; warp sampling runs to deadline or iteration cap, records largest backward step and bouncing CPUs.

Offline clears departing CPU from peers core, die, sibling and cache masks, updates per-core counts and threading flags, resets local state and refreshes global SMT maximum; disable orders topology detach, FPU revoke, map removal, interrupt migration, LAPIC offline, then soft disable.

STARTUP count is two with integrated APIC else zero; each attempt samples errors around send on newer LAPICs, waits for idle, pauses short or long by selector, masks errors and stops on send or accept failure; kick aborts on bad or absent APIC id.

Reliable walk only succeeds for user tasks reaching user mode and fails on kernel registers with frame pointers, missing returns, consumer refusal or unwinder corruption; user walk validates frames and stops on failure, backward progress, zero return or refusal.

Static-call validation requires trailing marker on trampolines and accepts narrow opcode sets for tail and non-tail sites; operation derives arithmetically from tail and null attributes; early update only during boot before init completes, writing a jump and syncing icache.

Trap analysis reads up to fifteen bytes at linearized address skipping prefixes and matches only pop-flags and interrupt-return; single-step restores pending trap, arms traps, sets flag, clears forced mark for flag-changing next insn and reports block-step permission.

Status translator munges ownership, encodes devices, stores inode twice plus mode, ownership, size, timestamps and blocks under checked window; mmap rejects sub-page offsets; alignment uses huge-page mask or personality plus randomization; low window bounds and guard gap are fixed.

Trusted-boot page install walks four levels, installs frame, releases leaf and clears top no-execute for low code; sleep is no-op when inactive; reduced-hardware hook reports no device; AP wait polls platform counter to counted value or timeout; secondary time state copies boot CPU slots.

locks.text: Warm-reset vector setup and teardown share a counter under RTC lock with IRQs saved; online transition holds vector lock across marking online and vector bringup; offline map removal holds vector lock while migration and LAPIC offline follow in fixed order.

Warp last value, maximum and counters update under a spin lock held only around sampling and updates with detection outside; static-call mutation holds text mutex across validate and patch; wakeup holds preemption off across INIT, STARTUP and status collection.

Local descriptor inspection holds address-space context lock during table and bounds checks; user frame copy disables faults only around the two user reads after range check; trusted-boot address space carries its own mmap and page-table locks.

state_machines.text: Secondary entry orders control regs, page-table switch, exception setup, early microcode, alive handshake, core and FPU init, RCU and clock announce, AP starting, TSC sync, delay calibrate, sibling init, then online under lock, NMI init, IRQs on, clockevent setup and idle.

TSC target skips when unsynchronized, adjustment valid or clock reliable; else delegates measurement, joins start barrier, measures warp, joins stop barrier, then compensates by observed warp with sign fix, programs adjust MSR and retries.

Bringup flows from INIT through zero or two timed STARTUP attempts with per-attempt send and accept checks to success only when both clear; offline flows from topology detach through FPU revoke, map removal, interrupt migration, LAPIC offline and soft disable into non-returning halt.

Stepping moves from arming to trap set, then forced mark for ordinary insns or unforced passthrough for flag-changing insns, with block step only when single-step permits; mapping search checks fixed hints and sizes, tries hint reuse, searches top-down then falls back to bottom-up.

Trusted-boot trampoline allocates top level once then identity-maps extent with halting on failure; suspend copies power registers and waking vector then maps sleep states to platform shutdown types; AP shutdown counts dying CPUs then polls platform wait counter to match or timeout.

Time init registers IRQ zero, tries high-precision timer with legacy fallback, then selects IRQ mode, inits legacy timers, finalizes delivery, inits cycle counter and enables low-power delay when present; TSC init checks features, calibrates, enables sched clock, checks reliability and registers clocksource.

structs.text: Monitor-wait handshake record holds control and status words; wait marker is 0xDEADBEEF and kexec halt marker is 0x4A17DEAD; legacy init delay is 10000 us with max-UINT default; topology keeps sibling, core and die masks plus setup mask and one-shot refresh flag.

Static-call selector orders call, cond-call placeholder, jump, return, cond-jump from zero; trampoline guard is 0F B9 CC; zeroing, return, warning and two unlock five-byte patterns are fixed; compat address helper widens through unsigned long.

User frame is next-pointer then return address; 32-bit mmap block orders address, length, prot, flags, fd, offset; trusted-boot mm reuses init root with set counts and locks; log fops expose read plus default seek; digest is 20 bytes with packed launch record.

Low mappings span 0x40000000 to 0x80000000 with 0x02000000 randomization; serial log uses base 0x60000 size 0x8000 with size field at 16 and payload at 24; AP wait timeout is one second; TXT bases are public 0xFED30000 and private 0xFED20000 with heap fields at 0x0300 and 0x0308.
